metadata.description: Local-first voice, transcription, media, translation, and memory tools powered by Yaps.

plugins.name: yaps-all
plugins.description: Get all 14 Yaps skills in one install: voice, media, translation, and memory. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-memory
plugins.description: Find or save notes in your Yaps memory vault, including past dictations. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-dictation
plugins.description: Type with your voice using Yaps on desktop. Get set up, fix a problem, or recover a recent dictation. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-transcription
plugins.description: Turn an audio or video file into text with Yaps. Good for interviews, podcasts, and voice memos. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-meeting-transcription
plugins.description: Make a meeting transcript with speaker labels in Yaps. Correct it, export it, or ask questions. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-srt-generator
plugins.description: Make a timed SRT subtitle file from audio or video with Yaps. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-auto-captions
plugins.description: Add captions to a video with Yaps. Review the words and timing, choose a style, then export. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-audio-cleaner
plugins.description: Reduce noise, hiss, and static in a speech recording with Yaps. Save a separate clean file. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-background-removal
plugins.description: Remove an image background with Yaps. Save a transparent PNG, solid background, or outlined sticker. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-image-generate
plugins.description: Create an image from a written prompt with Yaps. Save the result or make a sticker. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-text-to-speech
plugins.description: Turn text into spoken audio with Yaps. Choose a supported voice and language, then save the file. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-translation
plugins.description: Translate text or subtitle files with Yaps. Keep the original and preserve subtitle timing. New users: install Yaps and sign in.

plugins.name: yaps-video-to-audio
plugins.description: Save the sound from a video as MP3, WAV, or M4A with Yaps. New users: install Yaps and sign in.
